review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Normalize the helper that Docusaurus actually calls**

When a real document includes `(!/…!)`, this normalization is confined to `updatePathsInIncludesTests`; repo-wide references show that helper is used only by `server/remark-includes.test.ts`, whereas `docusaurus.config.ts` passes the unchanged `updatePathsInIncludes` to `remarkIncludes`. That production helper still calls `resolve(versionRootDir, dirname(includePath), href)`, so `dirname("/…")` overrides `versionRootDir` and the built site's link or image still points outside the version tree. Apply or share this normalization in `updatePathsInIncludes` and exercise that production callback.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->
